personality_one_liner: An earthy, grounded smart agriculture assistant combining warm organic paper tones with botanical green accents for a calming, human-centred farming experience.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, calm magazine-like rhythm with 16pt screen margins and 12pt card spacing.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Email/password login, sign up, and Emergent-managed Google login with instant validation.

states.empty: Clean input forms with floating placeholders
states.error: Inline error banner with retry option

screens.layout: Vertical scroll container with warm paper background, branding header, tab switcher (Login / Sign Up), input fields, Google social login button, and language selector.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Agriculture dashboard displaying crop status, weather, soil sensors, quick actions, and bilingual updates.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with organic pulse shimmer
states.empty: Prompt to add first field or crop with illustration
states.error: Retry banner with offline cache indicator

screens.layout: Vertical scrollable dashboard with sticky top header (greeting, weather badge, language & theme toggles), field overview card, quick action grid (Scanner, AI Chat, Weather, Market), recent crop health updates, and bottom navigation.

screens.name: Scanner
screens.purpose: Camera & gallery capture interface to scan crops for diseases, pests, and nutrient deficiencies with instant AI diagnosis.

states.loading: Animated scanning grid with checklist of AI verification steps
states.empty: Camera viewfinder ready with gallery picker prompt
states.error: Unable to detect image or blurry photo warning with recapture button

screens.layout: Camera preview / image container in upper half, diagnosis result breakdown with confidence gauge and actionable remedies in bottom sheet with sticky scan/retake buttons.

screens.name: AIChat
screens.purpose: Conversational agricultural expert assistant providing localized crop advice in English and Hindi.

states.loading: Typing indicator dots with organic pulse
states.empty: Suggested prompt chips (e.g. 'How to cure tomato blight?', 'Best fertilizer for wheat') and welcome greeting
states.error: Network retry button for failed message send

screens.layout: Header with agronomist avatar and language indicator, scrollable message history with left/right alignment, quick prompt chips, and sticky bottom input bar with voice/attachment buttons.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User profile and farm management containing name, age, pincode, country, address, photo, and account actions.

states.loading: Skeleton loader for profile fields and avatar
states.empty: Prompt to complete missing farm profile details
states.error: Save failure error banner with retry

screens.layout: Cover banner with avatar upload, editable form fields for Name, Age, Pincode, Country, and Address, logout button, and settings shortcuts.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: App configurations including language toggle (Hindi/English), theme toggle (Dark/Light), notifications, and help.
screens.layout: Grouped list of setting sections (Language, Theme, Notifications, About, Account) with interactive toggles and navigation rows.

hero_farm.alt: Lush green agricultural fields under clear sky

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the smart agriculture assistant (KrishiAI) mobile app with complete React Native Expo implementation. Ensure all user requirements are fully met: 1) Auth flow with Email/Password and Emergent-managed Google login, 2) Logout option, 3) Language toggle between Hindi and English (with dynamic state across screens), 4) Theme toggle between Dark and Light mode, 5) Agriculture-focused home screen with weather, soil sensors, field overview, and quick action tiles, 6) AI chat assistant with prompt chips and localized responses, 7) Crop scanner with camera/gallery selection and AI diagnosis breakdown, 8) Profile screen with Name, Age, Pincode, Country, Address, and Photo upload, 9) Settings screen for language, theme, and notifications. Use the Hand-Drawn / Journal personality palette (#FDFBF7 paper white, #4F6F52 botanical green, #F5F0E6 card surface). Adhere to all mobile UX rules: touch targets >= 44x44pt, safe area insets respected, loading/empty/error states on all screens, and no banned colors (indigo/violet/purple/navy). Save design guidelines at /app/design_guidelines.json.
